name: sombill
description: SomBill – public website, Manager/Waiter/Cashier dashboards and backend (API gateway + main API) and the current Supabase backend in database/. Convenience scripts only: frontend/ is an npm workspace (dashboards + packages), the website and backend keep their own dependencies.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix frontend/apps/website && npm ci --prefix frontend && corepack pnpm --dir backend install --frozen-lockfile && npm install --prefix database/supabase
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:backend: corepack pnpm --dir backend prisma:generate && corepack pnpm --dir backend build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && corepack pnpm --dir backend typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && corepack pnpm --dir backend lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix frontend run format && corepack pnpm --dir backend format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix frontend run format:check && corepack pnpm --dir backend format:check
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && npm run test:legacy && corepack pnpm --dir backend test
